noticias_reales.title: Nebius Just Raised $5 Billion in Convertible Notes Against a $1.4 Billion Revenue Base. Are We In a Bubble?
noticias_reales.summary: Nebius priced $5.0 billion of convertible senior notes on Wednesday, upsized from a proposed $4.5 billion. The notes convert at $313.46 and $324.65 per share, premiums of about 40% and 45% over Wednesday's close.

noticias_reales.title: AI's Absurd Spending Boom? Hyperscalers Are Spending 102% of Cloud Revenue on Capex
noticias_reales.summary: The artificial intelligence boom is turning corporate capital spending into a different kind of arms race.

noticias_reales.title: Why Did Nebius Stock Plunge This Week?
noticias_reales.summary: Nebius shareholders should expect more debt ahead. That's not necessarily a bad thing, though.

noticias_reales.title: Michael Burry Says the AI Buildout Is Repeating 2008: ‘The Shenanigans Are Apparent Today'
noticias_reales.summary: Michael Burry issued a fresh warning Friday that the AI data center boom mirrors the structural excesses that preceded 2008, arguing that circular financing, off-balance-sheet vehicles and captive insurers are quietly building leverage across the ecosystem.

noticias_reales.title: CoreWeave vs. Nebius Group: Which Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cloud Stock Has More Upside?
noticias_reales.summary: Nebius and CoreWeave are each dependent on a few large clients. Nebius is projected to grow at a faster pace.

victor_targets_detail.disclaimer: Reference ranges with declared assumptions — research classification, not investment advice or a promise of return.

victor_narrative: Sold $530M last fiscal year; revenue is growing strongly (+350.9%).
For every $100 in sales, $19 is net profit — profitable.
Generates real cash: $4.5B of free cash flow per year.
Owes $0.89 for every $1 of equity — manageable debt.
Quick score: 3.6/10, computed from 40 of 100 evidence points — categories without FMP data stay N/S (never fabricated).
If it keeps growing as it has and the market pays the same multiple, the stock would be worth ~$197.22 in 12 months (10% below the current price of $219.13).

Al no tener puntajes, no podemos saber cómo se desempeña NBIS en ninguno de estos frentes en este momento.
wbj_explanation.gates_y_perfil: Actualmente, no se ha asignado un perfil (como Momentum, Quality, Value, etc.) a NBIS, ya que el análisis no pudo completarse y el 'Perfil/Banda' se muestra como 'None'. Sin embargo, este análisis actual no puede confirmar ni actualizar esa tesis.

Los niveles importantes son precios clave donde el activo podría encontrar soporte (donde el precio podría rebotar al alza) o resistencia (donde el precio podría detener su subida). Las zonas de confluencia son rangos de precios donde se superponen niveles técnicos y de valuación, lo que les da más importancia.
